verdict.rationale: The API covers the core services: incorporation create/get, notarization, translation, tax registration (create and poll), trade registration, and webhooks. Several UI-facing capabilities have no API evidence, though. Apostilles, remote identity verification, the company-name availability check and the business-account offer appear only on marketing pages. Webhook URLs must be registered through the dashboard, and the Compliance API is limited to Enterprise plans. Missing for 10: API endpoints for apostille, identity verification and name-availability checks; programmatic webhook management; Compliance API access on all plans; a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404); and any independent confirmation that the API matches the UI.
